behaviours.title: Unknown account reads as zero balance and empty history
behaviours.given: a new Ledger with no accounts
behaviours.when: the balance and entries of account 'ghost' are read
behaviours.then: balance is 0 and entries is an empty list
behaviours.contrary_then: reading an unknown account throws an error
contrary_alternatives: balance is reported as undefined/null
the read creates the account with a balance of 0 and an opening entry

behaviours.title: Opening an existing account does not reset it
behaviours.given: account 'a' has received a deposit of 100 (txn 'd1')
behaviours.then: balance stays 100 and history still has the 1 deposit entry
behaviours.contrary_then: the account is reset to a balance of 0 with empty history
contrary_alternatives: opening an existing account throws an 'already open' error

behaviours.title: Deposit of 100 credits the account and records a deposit entry
behaviours.then: result is ok, balance is 100 and entries is [{txnId 'd1', kind 'deposit', amount 100}]
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is rejected because account 'a' was never opened, balance stays 0
contrary_alternatives: the deposit succeeds but no history entry is recorded

behaviours.title: Deposit of zero, negative or NaN amount is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.when: deposits of 0, -5 and NaN are made into 'a'
behaviours.then: each returns {ok:false, reason:'invalid-amount'} and balance stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: a deposit of 0 is accepted as a no-op returning ok
contrary_alternatives: a deposit of -5 is treated as a withdrawal

behaviours.title: Repeating a deposit with the same txnId is ignored but reports ok
behaviours.given: 100 has been deposited into 'a' with txn 'd1'
behaviours.when: another 100 is deposited into 'a' with txn 'd1'
behaviours.then: result is ok, balance stays 100 and there is 1 entry
behaviours.contrary_then: the duplicate is applied again and balance becomes 200
contrary_alternatives: the duplicate is rejected with reason 'duplicate' and balance stays 100

behaviours.title: Amount validation happens before duplicate detection
behaviours.given: 100 has been deposited into 'a' with txn 'd1'
behaviours.when: a deposit of 0 is made with txn 'd1'
behaviours.then: result is {ok:false, reason:'invalid-amount'}
behaviours.contrary_then: the call is treated as a duplicate and returns ok
contrary_alternatives: it is rejected with reason 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: Transaction ids are shared across all operation types
behaviours.given: 100 has been deposited into 'a' with txn 't1'
behaviours.then: result is ok but nothing happens: balance stays 100 and there is 1 entry
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal goes through (50 plus 0.50 fee) and balance becomes 49.5
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is rejected with reason 'duplicate' and balance stays 100

behaviours.title: Amounts are rounded to the nearest cent, half up: 1.005 becomes 1.01
behaviours.then: balance is 1.01 and the entry amount is 1.01
behaviours.contrary_then: the amount is truncated / floating-point rounded down and balance is 1
contrary_alternatives: the amount is kept unrounded at 1.005
an amount with more than 2 decimals is rejected

behaviours.title: Amounts below half a cent round down: 2.994 becomes 2.99
behaviours.then: balance is 2.99
behaviours.contrary_then: the amount is rounded up to 3
contrary_alternatives: the amount is kept at 2.994

behaviours.title: A deposit that rounds to zero cents is accepted and records a 0 entry
behaviours.then: result is ok, balance is 0 and one deposit entry of amount 0 is recorded
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is rejected as amount-too-small and no entry is recorded
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is rounded up to 0.01

behaviours.title: Entries returns a copy that cannot change the ledger
behaviours.when: the list returned by entries('a') is emptied by the caller
behaviours.then: entries('a') still returns 1 entry
behaviours.contrary_then: the ledger history is emptied too and entries('a') returns 0 entries
contrary_alternatives: modifying the returned list throws an error

behaviours.title: Foreign deposit converts amount by rate: 10 at 1.5 credits 15
behaviours.then: result is ok, balance is 15 with a 'deposit' entry of 15
behaviours.contrary_then: the raw amount 10 is credited without conversion
contrary_alternatives: the amount is divided by the rate and 6.67 is credited
a conversion fee is deducted

behaviours.title: Foreign deposit converted value is rounded to nearest cent: 10 at 0.12345 credits 1.23
behaviours.then: balance is 1.23
behaviours.contrary_then: the converted value is rounded up and balance is 1.24
contrary_alternatives: the unrounded 1.2345 is credited

behaviours.title: Foreign deposit with zero rate or non-positive amount is invalid-amount
behaviours.when: depositForeign is called with amount 10 and rate 0, and with amount -1 and rate 1.5
behaviours.then: both return {ok:false, reason:'invalid-amount'} and balance stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: a zero rate is accepted and credits 0 with ok
contrary_alternatives: a zero rate is rejected with reason 'amount-too-small'

behaviours.title: Foreign deposit that converts to under half a cent is rejected as amount-too-small and does not use up the txnId
behaviours.then: the foreign deposit returns {ok:false, reason:'amount-too-small'}; the later deposit with 'f1' goes through and balance is 5
behaviours.contrary_then: the foreign deposit is accepted with ok (crediting 0)
contrary_alternatives: the failed foreign deposit consumes 'f1' so the later deposit is ignored and balance stays 0
the value is rounded up to 0.01 and credited

behaviours.title: Repeating a foreign deposit with the same txnId is ignored
behaviours.then: result is ok and balance stays 15
behaviours.contrary_then: it is applied again and balance becomes 30
contrary_alternatives: it is rejected with reason 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: Small withdrawal is charged the minimum fee of 0.50
behaviours.then: result is ok, balance is 89.5 and the withdrawal entry amount is 10.5 (amount plus fee)
behaviours.contrary_then: only the 1% fee of 0.10 is charged and balance is 89.9
contrary_alternatives: no fee is charged and balance is 90
the fee is recorded as a separate entry of 0.5

behaviours.title: Withdrawal fee is 1% of the amount: withdrawing 100 costs 1.00
behaviours.then: balance is 899
behaviours.contrary_then: the minimum fee of 0.50 is charged and balance is 899.5
contrary_alternatives: no fee is charged and balance is 900
a 2% fee is charged and balance is 898

behaviours.title: At exactly 50 withdrawn the 1% fee equals the minimum 0.50
behaviours.then: balance is 49.5
behaviours.contrary_then: the fee is rounded up to 0.51 and balance is 49.49
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is fee-free and balance is 50

behaviours.title: Fractional-cent fees are rounded up: withdrawing 50.01 costs 0.51
behaviours.then: the fee is 0.51 and balance is 49.48
behaviours.contrary_then: the fee is rounded to nearest/down at 0.50 and balance is 49.49
contrary_alternatives: the exact fee 0.5001 is charged

behaviours.title: Withdrawal fee is capped at 25.00
behaviours.then: the fee is 25 (not 30) and balance is 6975
behaviours.contrary_then: the uncapped 1% fee of 30 is charged and balance is 6970
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal above 2500 is rejected

behaviours.title: Fee cap boundary: 2500 costs 25.00 and 2500.01 still costs 25.00
behaviours.then: 'a' balance is 7475 and 'b' balance is 7474.99
behaviours.contrary_then: 2500.01 is charged a 25.01 fee and 'b' balance is 7474.98
contrary_alternatives: the cap applies only above 2500 so 'a' pays 25 and 'b' pays 25.01

behaviours.title: Withdrawal can use the whole balance including the fee
behaviours.then: result is ok and balance is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: it is rejected as insufficient-funds and balance stays 10.5
contrary_alternatives: the fee is waived when it would empty the account and balance is 0.5

behaviours.title: Withdrawal is refused when balance covers the amount but not the fee
behaviours.then: result is {ok:false, reason:'insufficient-funds'} and balance stays 10.49
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted and balance becomes -0.01
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is accepted with a reduced fee leaving 0

behaviours.title: Withdrawal from an account that was never funded is insufficient-funds
behaviours.then: result is {ok:false, reason:'insufficient-funds'} and balance is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: it is rejected as an unknown account
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is allowed and balance becomes -1.5

behaviours.title: Withdrawal of zero or negative amount is invalid-amount
behaviours.then: both return {ok:false, reason:'invalid-amount'} and balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: withdrawing 0 is accepted and charges the 0.50 minimum fee, leaving 99.5
contrary_alternatives: withdrawing -10 is treated as a deposit

behaviours.title: Repeating a withdrawal with the same txnId is ignored
behaviours.given: account 'a' has 100 and 10 was withdrawn with txn 'w1' (balance 89.5)
behaviours.then: result is ok and balance stays 89.5
behaviours.contrary_then: it is applied again and balance becomes 79
contrary_alternatives: it is rejected with reason 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: A refused withdrawal does not use up its txnId
behaviours.given: account 'a' has 5 and a withdrawal of 10 with txn 'w1' was refused for insufficient funds
behaviours.when: 10 more is deposited and the withdrawal of 10 with 'w1' is retried
behaviours.then: the retry succeeds and balance is 4.5
behaviours.contrary_then: the retry is treated as a duplicate and balance stays 15
contrary_alternatives: the retry is rejected with reason 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: Withdrawing exactly the 5000 limit is allowed; one more cent afterwards hits daily-limit
behaviours.then: the 5000 withdrawal succeeds (balance 4975), the 0.01 withdrawal returns {ok:false, reason:'daily-limit'} and balance stays 4975
behaviours.contrary_then: the 0.01 withdrawal goes through and balance becomes 4974.49
contrary_alternatives: the 5000 withdrawal itself is refused as reaching the limit

behaviours.title: A single withdrawal of 5000.01 is refused as daily-limit and does not count toward the limit
behaviours.then: the first returns {ok:false, reason:'daily-limit'}; the second succeeds and balance is 4975
behaviours.contrary_then: the 5000.01 withdrawal goes through
contrary_alternatives: the refused attempt counts toward the limit so the 5000 withdrawal is also refused

behaviours.title: Daily limit counts withdrawn amounts only, not fees
behaviours.then: both succeed, making exactly 5000 withdrawn, and balance is 4974.5
behaviours.contrary_then: the 10 withdrawal is refused as daily-limit because fees count, and balance stays 4985
contrary_alternatives: the limit is per-transaction, so further withdrawals keep succeeding

behaviours.title: Daily limit is cumulative per account across withdrawals
behaviours.then: the first two succeed (balance 4955), the 0.01 returns {ok:false, reason:'daily-limit'}
behaviours.contrary_then: the limit is per withdrawal so 0.01 succeeds
contrary_alternatives: the 2000 withdrawal is refused because it exceeds a remaining allowance

behaviours.title: Insufficient funds is reported before the daily limit
behaviours.then: result is {ok:false, reason:'insufficient-funds'}
behaviours.contrary_then: result is {ok:false, reason:'daily-limit'}
contrary_alternatives: both reasons are reported together

behaviours.title: Daily limit is tracked per account
behaviours.given: accounts 'a' and 'b' each have 10000 and 5000 has been withdrawn from 'a'
behaviours.then: it succeeds and 'b' balance is 4975
behaviours.contrary_then: it is refused as daily-limit because the limit is shared

behaviours.title: Transfer of the whole balance moves money without a fee
behaviours.when: 100 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' with txn 't1'
behaviours.then: result is ok, 'a' is 0, 'b' is 100; 'a' gets a 'transfer-out' entry of 100 and 'b' a 'transfer-in' entry of 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is refused as insufficient-funds because a fee applies
contrary_alternatives: a fee is charged and 'b' receives 99
the transfer is refused because 'b' was never opened

behaviours.title: Transfer of more than the balance is refused
behaviours.then: result is {ok:false, reason:'insufficient-funds'}; 'a' stays 100 and 'b' stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer goes through and 'a' becomes -0.01
contrary_alternatives: only the available 100 is transferred

behaviours.title: Transfer of zero amount is invalid-amount
behaviours.then: result is {ok:false, reason:'invalid-amount'}
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is accepted as a no-op with ok

behaviours.title: Repeating a transfer with the same txnId is ignored
behaviours.given: account 'a' had 100 and 40 was transferred to 'b' with txn 't1'
behaviours.then: result is ok; 'a' stays 60 and 'b' stays 40
behaviours.contrary_then: it is applied again: 'a' becomes 20 and 'b' 80
contrary_alternatives: it is rejected with reason 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: Split of 100 among 3 gives the extra cent to the first recipient
behaviours.contrary_then: the extra cent goes to the last recipient: 'b' 33.33, 'c' 33.33, 'd' 33.34
contrary_alternatives: each gets 33.33 and the leftover cent stays with 'a' (0.01)
the split is refused because it does not divide evenly

behaviours.title: Split of 0.05 among 3 gives 0.02, 0.02, 0.01
behaviours.contrary_then: remaining cents go to the last recipients: 'b' 0.01, 'c' 0.02, 'd' 0.02
contrary_alternatives: all extra cents go to the first recipient: 'b' 0.03, 'c' 0.01, 'd' 0.01

behaviours.title: Split with no recipients is refused
behaviours.then: result is {ok:false, reason:'no-recipients'} and 'a' stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the split is accepted as a no-op with ok
contrary_alternatives: the amount is debited from 'a' and lost

behaviours.title: Split checks amount first, then recipients, then duplicate txnId
behaviours.then: the first returns reason 'invalid-amount'; the second returns reason 'no-recipients' even though 'd1' was already used
behaviours.contrary_then: the second is treated as a duplicate and returns ok
contrary_alternatives: the first returns reason 'no-recipients'

behaviours.title: Split of more than the balance is refused
behaviours.then: result is {ok:false, reason:'insufficient-funds'}; 'a' stays 10 and 'b' stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the split goes through and 'a' becomes -0.01
contrary_alternatives: only the available 10 is split, 5 each

behaviours.title: Split of the exact balance is allowed; repeating its txnId is ignored
behaviours.given: account 'a' has 10 and 10 was split to ['b','c'] with txn 's1'
behaviours.when: the same split with txn 's1' is repeated
behaviours.then: the first split left 'a' 0, 'b' 5, 'c' 5; the repeat returns ok and nothing changes
behaviours.contrary_then: the repeat is refused as insufficient-funds
contrary_alternatives: the repeat is rejected with reason 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: Interest for a full 365-day year at 5% on 1000 is 50
behaviours.then: result is ok, balance is 1050 with an 'interest' entry of 50
behaviours.contrary_then: a 360-day year is used and balance is 1050.69
contrary_alternatives: interest is compounded daily giving 1051.27

behaviours.title: Interest is rounded down to the cent: 30 days at 5% on 1000 gives 4.10
behaviours.then: 4.10 is credited (exact 4.1096) and balance is 1004.1
behaviours.contrary_then: interest is rounded to nearest and balance is 1004.11
contrary_alternatives: a 360-day year gives 4.17

behaviours.title: Interest below one cent credits nothing, reports ok, and leaves the txnId unused
behaviours.then: interest returns ok with no entry; the later deposit with 'i1' is applied and balance is 6
behaviours.contrary_then: the interest call consumes 'i1' so the deposit is ignored and balance stays 1
contrary_alternatives: the interest call is refused with reason 'amount-too-small'
interest is rounded up to 0.01

behaviours.title: Interest with zero rate or zero days is invalid-amount
behaviours.when: applyInterest with rate 0 / 30 days, and with rate 5 / 0 days
behaviours.then: both return {ok:false, reason:'invalid-amount'} and balance stays 1000
behaviours.contrary_then: they are accepted as no-ops returning ok

behaviours.title: Repeating interest with the same txnId is ignored
behaviours.given: account 'a' had 1000 and applyInterest('a', 5, 365, 'i1') made it 1050
behaviours.then: result is ok and balance stays 1050
behaviours.contrary_then: interest is applied again on 1050 and balance becomes 1102.5
contrary_alternatives: it is rejected with reason 'duplicate'
